public_brief.context: 11th-floor concrete pour; a delay shifts the programme by roughly 2-3 days.
public_brief.formwork: Measured deformation is inside the allowed tolerance but higher than previous floors. A recheck costs roughly two hours.
public_brief.crane: Wind is 11-12 m/s. Formal operating limit is 15 m/s. Forecast says wind may increase during the next hour.
public_brief.workers: Two experienced workers briefly used the wrong fall-protection anchor. It is corrected. First violation allows managerial discretion after formal record and rebriefing.

facts.text: Initial formwork deformation measurement is inside formal tolerance.
Current wind is 11-12 m/s and the formal crane limit is 15 m/s.
Second formwork measurement remains inside formal tolerance.
